entities.name: Storm Crane Monastery
entities.description: Mobile Jeskai sanctuary and skyship on Tarkir led by Narset.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Archangel who sought Narset's counsel about dragonstorms.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: Narset's advisor who urged her to turn Elspeth away.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that devastated the Ojutai brood.

entities.name: Dragon's Eye Sanctuary
entities.description: Sanctuary that fell during the invasion.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker whose wake left unstable energies.

events.summary: Survivors led by Narset build the monastery from the ruins.
events.quote: they constructed the Storm Crane Monastery as both a refuge and a mobile bastion of knowledge

events.summary: Elspeth arrives seeking Narset's counsel on worsening dragonstorms.
events.quote: arrived on the Storm Crane Monastery seeking Narset’s counsel

events.summary: A wild dragon breaches the monastery; Narset and Elspeth drive it off.
events.quote: Narset and Elspeth fought side by side to protect the trapped students

events.summary: Taigam urges Narset to turn Elspeth away; Narset defies the council and leaves with her.

relations.quote: The monastery is led by Narset

relations.note: Leaves with her to fight the storms
